title: Canonical Equivalence of Complex and Lagrangian Quantizations
exact_target: Construct a natural identification between the Hilbert spaces from complex and Lagrangian polarizations of the same symplectic manifold.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004285 (OWR-17292-011). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Applications (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/49, pp. 3053--3140. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 73.
Hattori--Yamashita, spectral convergence in geometric quantization (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Hattori--Yamashita, toric symplectic manifolds (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The prequantum data, singular-fiber treatment and any half-form corrections must match. Equality of dimensions or existence of some vector-space isomorphism is weaker than the canonical comparison requested.
